description:
Retire the private file-backed repository and executor setups of the library unit tests.

## Background

Shared test support constructs an initialised file-backed repository from caller-supplied configuration, an executor over a file-backed root, and a temporary declaration directory. Helpers that only arrange paths or mutate a repository they are given are scenario steps, for example `linked_checkout_paths` in `commands/worktree.rs`. JSON-backend unit tests in `storage/json.rs` construct the backend they test. The helpers below duplicate the shared constructors or open an executor over a store they are given.

This entry covers `gate_check.rs`, `claim.rs`, `hooks.rs`.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs`: `create_test_issue` (`:1045`).
- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs`: `setup_file_repository` (`:2077`), `ReuseFixture::new` (`:2149`).
- `crates/jit/src/commands/hooks.rs`: `diverged_strict_repo` (`:254`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each helper the Background lists no longer exists, and its tests obtain the repository, executor or declaration directory from the shared constructors.
- [hard] REQ-03: No library test module defines a function that creates a file-backed repository, opens a file-backed executor or writes a declaration directory of its own; scenario content stays in the tests as data.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: Gate, claim and hook tests use the shared file-backed constructors
